items.title: Russian military report claims 1,065 Ukrainian casualties and 268 drones intercepted
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry claimed Ukrainian forces lost approximately 1,065 personnel over the preceding day and said its air defences shot down 268 drones and eight Neptune missiles. These are Russian military figures, not independently established battlefield totals.

items.title: Russian-linked account alleges widespread looting in Sloviansk
items.summary: A Russian military-linked report alleges Ukrainian troops have been breaking into abandoned homes, apartments and garages in Sloviansk as residents flee the fighting. It cites an anonymous local resident who described theft of vehicles, furniture and appliances, and accused police of failing to intervene.

items.title: APEC summit declaration omits Ukraine despite leaders' peace discussions
items.summary: The final declaration of the APEC summit in Shenzhen addressed energy security, financial stability, digital technology and anti-corruption cooperation but made no mention of Ukraine. The omission came as the leaders of Russia, China and the United States separately discussed the war at their trilateral meeting.

items.title: Report raises Kursk drone-attack injury toll to eleven
items.summary: A subsequent report put the number of people injured in the Ukrainian drone attack on Kursk at eleven, including a 12-year-old child. Earlier regional reporting cited nine injured, so the higher figure represents a reported update rather than a settled count.
